summary: Rewrote upload_file for the v3 API and the upload client standard: plan-based chunk size, parts numbered from 1, sha256/base64 part checksums and the base64url file checksum, resuming via the received-parts listing, and handling of parts_missing and upload_expired. Verified with the existing unit test and ad-hoc fake-transport checks against the docs examples; not run against a real Hollin server.
